rows.en: Realizing that Sheryl's song was meant for Alto and the others on the battlefield,
rows.notes: Sentence runs over 4148-4149; cut at the clause boundary (the Japanese cuts before 'realized').

rows.en: Ranka found herself joining in with a song of her own.
When the song crossed space-time and flowed from Alto's earring, an anomaly occurred.
Drawn by the singing, the Vajra had folded toward the Frontier fleet.
A swarm of Vajra bore down on Sheryl's concert venue.
The citizens of the Frontier fleet fled in panic.
And Ranka, who had made herself a decoy, was captured by the Vajra.
But Sheryl, whose concert had been cut short, began to sing again.
Ranka noticed, and she began to sing as well.
Reacting to Sheryl and Ranka's voices, the Vajra fell into confusion.
Seizing that opening, S.M.S. and the Battle Frontier attacked,
drove off the giant Vajra battleship, and the Vajra withdrew.
rows.notes: 'Vajra battleship' not in glossary as a unit name; translated literally (lowercase).

rows.en: And so the Frontier fleet repelled the Vajra attack.
On Island 1, snow began to fall, as if to announce the end of the battle.
Yet the damage from this battle was far from small.
And above all, the Vajra threat had not truly passed...
The U.N. Forces stood helpless before the crushing assault of Ingues's Mardook Army.
rows.notes: Ingues: glossary status 'wiki'. Mardook Army from the glossary alias.

rows.en: Silvie took Hibiki and slipped aboard the Macross.
With a surprise attack harnessing the Macross's runaway energy,
they aimed to turn the tables by taking down Ingues.
rows.notes: Subject restored as 'they' (Silvie and Hibiki, from 4165).

rows.en: The Macross rose up and fired its main cannon at Ingues's ship.
But even with the Macross's runaway energy behind it,
the attack had no effect at all on the Mardook Mothership.
Hibiki and Silvie despaired at that overwhelming power.
But Ishtar, who had secretly come aboard the Macross, did not give up.
Ishtar called out to the Mardook Army to stop fighting.
Her plea seemed about to reach the Emulators,
rows.notes: Sentence runs over 4174-4175. Emulator as in mission row u0370.

rows.en: but Ingues began punishing those who disobeyed him with death.
Seeing Ingues's punishments, Ishtar,
her heart full of feelings, sang a song of love.
And on hearing that song, Feff at last rose up against Ingues.
To protect the Mardook, and to protect Ishtar.
rows.notes: Deliberate fragment, kept as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Under a full barrage from the entire fleet, Ingues perished along with his ship.
The battle ended, and a peace treaty was signed between the Mardook and Earth.
With Earth's crisis over, Ishtar set off together with Feff and the others.
To build a culture for the Mardook, far out in space...

uncertain: u4164 Ingues (glossary status 'wiki'); u4165/u4171 Hibiki Kanzaki needs_check; u4170 Mardook Mothership provisional.
u4148-4149: Japanese cuts between the object clause and 'Ranka realized'; English cuts after the participial clause instead (same sentence, same two rows).
